video_title: Richard Jefferson Defends the Lakers’ Expectations Despite Their Hot Start

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on whether the Mavericks are legitimate title contenders
quotes.excerpt: I think I deserve a pass. This is not a pancake flipping moment.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: Have they shown you enough that they are legitimate title contenders?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I would not go that far, but I will say this, I think I deserve a pass. This is not a pancake flipping moment. Because I picked Anthony Edwards to win the MVP and he got injured, I think I deserve to be able to pick somebody else. I picked Luka Doncic last year to start the season, so I think I am able to switch.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on why the Mavericks aren't title contenders yet
quotes.excerpt: I don't believe that they're title contenders yet because they haven't got a real signature win yet.
quotes.quote: Luka is going to be in the MVP conversation. I don't believe that they're title contenders yet because they haven't got a real signature win yet. I still haven't seen, they haven't beat an OKC, although OKC is injured, they haven't beat a Houston Rockets team or the Spurs. I need that moment to to audit the Knicks or something like that. Detroit, yeah, no Jaylen Brown. That's cool, but I need a real signature win type moment.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins predicts JJ Redick will win Coach of the Year
quotes.excerpt: If I had to pick somebody in this short season, JJ Redick will win Coach of the Year.
quotes.quote: If I had to pick somebody in this short season, JJ Redick will win Coach of the Year. Because I didn't say it out loud, but I was watching this fucking ass. I wanted to know what he was going to be like post LeBron James. And what he has done, when you look at the rest of those guys' numbers on the squad, all of them are shooting high percentage, playing excellent basketball. And when I see that, they're actually competing on both ends of the floor, JJ has the attention and the ears of that locker room that's sitting at the top of the Western Conference.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the top teams in the Western Conference
quotes.excerpt: San Antonio, I think universally across the board. I think OKC, universally across the board.
quotes.quote: San Antonio, I think universally across the board. I think OKC, universally across the board from just kind of even, you know, GMs across the line would be like, hey, these are the two teams that we're kind of looking at to be top of the West if healthy. So right now, they're starting at three. Now you get to the conversation between Minnesota who just added LaMelo Ball. So that's LaMelo. Now again, Anthony Edwards goes down. Like we don't know this, but how did, how did, how did Anthony Edwards start the season? On a tear. How is LaMelo Ball playing? On a tear, as predicted, right? So now you're talking about those top three, right? So then when you start getting is, hey man, Houston could be a problem, which they look like they are. Houston looks like they could be a problem. So now we talking about fourth, fifth.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on why the Lakers are a top-tier team
quotes.excerpt: The Lakers, you know, if they're healthy, they can finish three, one, two, they can finish anywhere.
quotes.quote: San Antonio went to the finals, OKC won a championship. We didn't even get to mention Denver. We didn't even get to mention some of these other teams that like, Portland who's now in the mix. So for us to say respectfully that the Lakers, you know, if they're healthy, they can finish three, one, two, they can finish anywhere. But the same point in time for you to at the start of the season to evaluate rosters and say, hey look, I have San Antonio who just went to the finals, I got OKC who was a game seven away from going to the finals with one of their best players out. I got those teams. I like LaMelo, right, addition. So I got the Lakers four or five. That's not disrespectful. That's not disrespectful to the Lakers. Now the Lakers have exceeded expectations, maybe not in their own locker room, but to your point, JJ Redick has done an outstanding job.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson praises JJ Redick's coaching performance
quotes.excerpt: JJ Redick is an outstanding coach. No coach is perfect like no player is perfect.
quotes.quote: JJ Redick is an outstanding coach. No coach is perfect like no player is perfect. Coaches can have good series just like players can have like like good series or bad series. So like when I look at JJ I'm like, dude, he is a great, I don't want to call him young, but he's still in the early stages of his coaching career. He's a young coach, yeah, for sure. He makes you forget. He makes you forget, but I'm like, JJ is a great coach. JJ is doing what he was meant to do. He's got a roster that he is managing and doing a great job. Always got one of the best players in the league. End of story. So it's like, I just don't think it was a slight now that the Lakers are here where they are right now for everyone to be like, oh wait.

quotes.speaker: Allie Clifton
quotes.summary_phrase: Allie Clifton on the Lakers' early season performance
quotes.excerpt: 11 and two after the first 13 and you think about the two games that they've lost.
quotes.quote: 11 and two after the first 13 and you think about the two games that they've lost, they blew a 25 point lead to the Golden State Warriors and the 41 free throws, excuse me, that led to the flopping discussion against the Portland Trail Blazers. But if if was the fifth, we'd all be drunk. Fanatics Sportsbook has the Lakers with the fifth best odds to win the West behind the Spurs, Thunder, Rockets, and Timberwolves still, currently at plus 1100.
